Name: Game ID
notes: Unique battle id. Never use sys_id here.

Name: Campaign Turn
notes: Which campaign round this battle belongs to.

Name: Played On
notes: Calendar date of the tabletop game.

Name: System
notes: Where the battle was fought. Both force tokens should be in this system at the time of the game.

Name: Points Limit
notes: Agreed points size for this battle.

Name: Attacker Force
notes: The map token that attacked. There is no separate fleet FK. Future characters in this battle hang off this force_id plus game_id.

Name: Defender Force
notes: The map token that defended. Same rules as attacker_force_id.

Name: Result
type: enum (attacker_win, defender_win, draw, conceded, in_progress, unable_to_schedule, no_show, no_report)
notes: Use in_progress for scheduled but unplayed games. unable_to_schedule closes the battle with no VP, strength, durability, or control change after the opponent confirms. no_show names the opponent in no_show_id; the campaign admin confirms it; the reporter's force wins and that player gains +1 action on the next turn only. no_report is admin-only: a Battles deadline flags an unreported open battle, or the admin marks one. Confirm applies a loss to both forces and changes neither victory points nor control. Reject returns the battle to open.

Name: Winner
notes: The winning player, not a warlord. Must match attacker_id or defender_id. Empty when result is draw or in_progress.

Name: Attacker List
notes: Optional snapshot of the list / rite used that day. Force record may change later.

Name: Notes
example: Warlord duel: both survived. Traitor titan support delayed.
notes: Free text for narrative. Named-character outcomes (duels, death, relics) stay here until a db_characters sheet exists. Do not add structured kill/relic columns on this sheet.

Name: No-show player
notes: Set only when result is no_show. Must be the attacker or the defender
column8: and a player report can name only the opponent.
